name: Ulauncher
description: Core has no self-updater. Extension marketplace downloads a git-ref-addressed tarball over HTTPS and executes it via sys.executable — no signing, no checksum independent of the live git ref (content-as-code).
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Ulauncher has a separate extension-content channel that resolves compatible Git refs to commits. The reviewed source does not establish independent publisher authentication for that channel or a primary-application self-updater.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than historical release re-verification; extension URL parsing for non-GitHub hosts, server-side ref integrity, caller-supplied runtime commands, and shipped marketplace behavior remain outside this review.
